# UPchieve Changelog, week of Oct 24 to Oct 31, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Oct 30, subway Oct 30. These deploys carried the NTHS targeting, session offers, My Coaches, job registry, session report, and Node work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Put a dot on the NTHS sidebar link while an approved president's chapter is waiting to be created,** labeled "Create your NTHS chapter" ([high-line !2035](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2035)), with `NTHS_CHAPTER_CREATION_DOT_SHOWN` and `NTHS_CHAPTER_CREATED` PostHog events for when the dot shows and when a chapter is created ([high-line !2036](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2036)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Make NTHS members, admins, and presidents targetable:** `isNthsMember`, `isNthsAdmin`, and `isNthsPresident` person properties in PostHog, from the user's active chapter membership, with president meaning the President title ([subway !3095](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3095)); the same three in SendGrid's contact fields, synced after each membership change ([subway !3096](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3096)); and in Gleap's custom data ([high-line !2025](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2025)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Let staff manage a chapter member from `/admin/nths/member`:** change a member's title or admin role, or remove them from the chapter, through the same update path Chapter HQ uses, so Retool's Manage member button can link there instead of running its own queries. Staff can remove or demote a chapter's last admin, and Chapter HQ now refuses a removal that also changes role or title, or a role or title change on someone who already left. ([subway !3109](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3109), [high-line !2033](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2033)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Check school-affiliated chapters for official status through the impact path too.** The impact-path status job skipped chapters affiliated with a school, which counted as official anyway. It checks every chapter now. ([subway !3108](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3108)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- **Renew chapters for next school year, with a named president:** 🧪 renewal dates read from a Google Sheet that program staff can change without a release. It shares the checklist sheet's loader, so the checklist now keeps its last good copy for 5 minutes after a failed read instead of retrying on every request ([subway !3104](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3104)); 🧪 the rules for which renewal prompt a member sees, from the dates and their chapter's state, returned on each chapter from `GET /nths-groups` ([subway !3105](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3105), [subway !3106](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3106)); 🧪 chapter admins see who is named as next year's president and who named them ([subway !3113](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3113)), and can change that, with an admin who names themselves accepting in the same step ([subway !3116](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3116)); 🧪 a named successor accepts by agreeing to every program commitment and becomes an admin titled President, while presidents who weren't named lose the title and stay admins ([subway !3115](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3115)); 🧪 a named successor can also decline, losing the title and staying an admin ([subway !3114](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3114)); 🎁 an hourly job sends each renewing chapter its renewal emails (nominations open, named successor, member stage, chapter closed) and, the day after the close date, closes a chapter nobody confirmed as president. A chapter with no members closes even with the flag off ([subway !3127](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3127)). Rolled out to no one yet ([`nths-chapter-renewal`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/1015555)). *Ben Wheeler*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- **Show coaches and students the people they've worked with:** 🚀 `/volunteers/past-students`, listing every student a coach has worked with and their last session, for a My Students page where a coach can start a DM ([subway !3098](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3098)); 🚀 each coach's latest session with the student, and the coach's public profile stats, added to My Coaches' data ([subway !3090](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3090)); 🎁 one card for both pages, offering a DM to coaches and a DM or a session request to students ([high-line !2027](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2027)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Give each coach-student pair one DM thread, apart from session recaps:** a conversations table, with a row from the first message either one sends ([subway !3085](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3085)); a messages table for what they send ([subway !3086](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3086)); when each of them last read the thread, so unread DMs can show the way they do on session recaps ([subway !3100](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3100)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Move requesting a specific coach from the cache into the database, ahead of launching it:** 🎁 subway reads and writes that state instead of Redis, holds back other coaches' holds and notifications while the student waits for the coach they asked for, and texts the requested coach only if they haven't opted out of texts ([subway !3088](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3088)); 🧪 high-line uses it, so a refresh still knows the student is waiting, and the "breakout" prompt becomes "open to all" and comes after 3 minutes instead of 5 ([high-line !2020](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2020)). Requesting a coach reaches 60% of students with at least one session ([`student-request-specific-volunteer-sessions`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/713196)). *Trey Stevens*
- 👀 **Show whether each coach is online, in a session, or offline, for the My Coaches redesign:** subway tracks whether a coach is connected anywhere on UPchieve over sockets ([subway !3124](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3124)); a `useCoachStatuses` composable the page can hook into ([high-line !2038](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2038)). *Trey Stevens*
- 👀 **Let a student request a coach from My Coaches, picking the subject:** the subject list holds only subjects the coach is certified in ([subway !3128](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3128)); a request-coach button that serves both that flow and the current one from Session History and Session Recap, where the subject is already known ([high-line !2041](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2041)). *Trey Stevens*

## Coach queue

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online. Earlier digests called this Session holds.

- **Rank coaches for each request and record the offers without making them:** 🧪 coaches score 1 point a minute for how long they've waited for a session since coming online or finishing their last one, 3 a minute after 30 minutes, up to 100 ([subway !3089](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3089)); 🧪 plus 1 point a day since their last session, 2 a day after a week, up to 50, counting only sessions over the minimum length ([subway !3103](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3103)); 🧪 plus 30 points for a coach with 2 to 6 sessions this calendar year, with each metric naming the data it needs so data that several metrics share is read once per request ([subway !3112](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3112)); 🧪 each offer records the scorecard version it was scored with ([subway !3102](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3102)); 🧪 offers stop storing their scoring input, since the facts are kept with the output ([subway !3122](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3122)); 🎁 and the column is dropped ([subway !3123](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3123)). No one sees a change: it records a ranking for every request outside onboarding sessions ([`shadow-session-offers`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/999532)). *sammy nave*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **Give urgent hotfixes a way past the tests.** Setting `TEST_DISABLED` on a fresh pipeline in GitLab skips the tests, and the test job becomes optional so it can be cancelled; cancelling it alone still doesn't let the MR merge ([subway !3029](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3029)). The README's hotfix steps were clarified after review ([subway !3101](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3101)). *Jamie Kasulis*

## Component library

Pulling high-line's presentation components out of the components that handle data, so non-engineers can change how the app looks without affecting how it works.

- ✅ **Lint the presentation components for hand-written design values.** stylelint on `src/components/PresentationComponents/` only: colors, spacing, radius, fonts, and transitions there must use a variable or mixin from `src/scss/setup`, checked on pre-commit and in CI. ([high-line !1998](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1998)) *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- **Let program volunteers auto-join requests that have waited:** 🚀 America Counts volunteers join a request once it's about 3 minutes old instead of right away, checking again when their tab comes back to the front ([high-line !1939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1939)); 👀 federal work-study (`fws`) volunteers auto-join the same way, with no grade level or sub-topic requirements ([high-line !1940](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1940)). *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Shorten the reCAPTCHA notice to "This site is protected by reCAPTCHA."** Since April 2026, Google treats reCAPTCHA as our data processor, so the notice no longer has to link Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. ([high-line !2039](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2039)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Skip the Redis read when refreshing a single-role user's roles.** A forced role refresh read Redis before fetching roles from Postgres. Now it goes to Postgres first and reads Redis only for users with more than one role, to keep their active role. ([subway !3126](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3126)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Type job names and payloads from the `jobProcessors` registry.** The `Jobs` enum goes away: `QueueService.add` only takes a key of `jobProcessors`, its job data is type-checked against that job, and adding a job no longer means updating the enum too. ([subway !3081](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3081)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Drop the transaction around `getLegacyUserObject`,** which only reads. ([subway !3125](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3125)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Tidy two corners of the NTHS code:** the member update parser moved from the nths-groups router into `NTHSGroupsService`, ending the only router-to-router import ([subway !3120](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3120)); one `createChapterMember` seed helper in place of four copies across the NTHS database specs ([subway !3121](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3121)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Add ESLint to subway** with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order get caught. ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Stop formatting markdown in the chat box.** Typing `*hello*` turned it italic in the box, but it sent as plain `hello`. 🐛 [#752](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/752) ([high-line !2037](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2037)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Save availability at the right hours outside Eastern time.** Since the switch from Moment to Day.js, saving shifted hours the wrong way: 2 pm Pacific saved as 11 am Eastern instead of 5 pm, so coaches got texts at 8 am. Loading shifted them back the same wrong way, so the calendar still showed 2 pm. 🐛 [#728](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/728) ([high-line !1938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1938)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🚀 **Show dollar amounts in chat as text, not math.** A message with two dollar amounts turned everything between the `$` signs italic, dropped its spaces, and hid the signs, for both people. The chat checks for real math nodes now instead of a pair of `$` in the text. 🐛 [#750](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/750) ([high-line !2023](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2023)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- **Let students with unfinished assignments load their dashboard.** The dashboard expected `completedSessions` on each assignment, and crashed for these students when the API didn't send it: 🚀 the assignments list copes with it missing and no longer divides by zero ([high-line !2031](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2031)); 👀 subway sends `completedSessions` again ([subway !3107](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3107)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Ask for the grade in the current school year on student sign-up.** The eligibility form's grade field still said "Grade in 2025-2026"; it takes the year from today's date now. ([high-line !2030](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2030)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Fix two slips in the profile page's phone number section.** Save didn't go back to Edit after saving a number, and the SMS consent checkbox didn't show after adding a new one. ([high-line !2034](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2034)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Store the person who filed a session report as its reporter.** Reports a student filed were stored as if the coach had reported the student. Only the session's student or coach can file one now. ([subway !3092](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3092)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Upgrade high-line to Node 24.22.1 to patch [a remote code execution hole in its Brotli decoder](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases#nodejs-brotli-decoder-out-of-bounds-write-permits-remote-code-execution-cve-2026-111497---high).** subway got it last week. ([high-line !2026](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2026)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Steady the NTHS sign-up test.** It drew phone numbers from only 9,000 values, so test users sometimes collided; it uses `getPhoneNumber` now. ([subway !3110](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3110)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🎁 **Take a new Clever student's grade from Clever.** New Clever students were asked to confirm their grade level on the dashboard, because sign-up didn't pull it in. Signing up or linking an account through Clever takes Clever's grade now, over the sign-up form's when there are both. 🐛 [#736](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/736) ([subway !3119](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3119)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🎁 **Mark the right recap DMs as read.** Session Recap showed its chat before the recap session loaded, so it sent `undefined` as the session id and, after another recap had been open, marked that earlier session's messages read instead. The chat waits for the session now, and leaving the page clears it. ([high-line !2040](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2040)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Switch back to the desktop layout when an iPad's Safari sidebar closes.** Closing it could leave the app in its phone layout while the CSS went back to desktop, a broken mix until reload. 🐛 [#749](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/749) ([high-line !2044](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2044)) *Kasozi Wilson*
